guard/30713.htm.text: Guard Gardner: Hello, do you wish to journey to the east? Then you might pass through the Forest of Mirrors... If you hear a voice behind you while traveling through the Forest of Mirrors, never look back. Have a nice trip...

guard/30713-1.htm.text: Guard Gardner: In the past it was known as the Forest of Doppelgangers. Monsters there masqueraded as known Men and attacked unwary victims...
